title: Derived constant tensor comparison for the fixed-scalar coefficient inverse image
statement: Let f:Y→X be a morphism of schemes and A a commutative ring in the independent coefficient universe. Let S and R be the constant A-ring sheaves on the coefficient-sized pro-etale sites of X and Y. Let E be the exact constant-scalar equivalence from R-modules to fixed-scalar A-module sheaves on Y [def-sfb-coefficient-fixed-derived-models], and F be constant-scalar restriction on X followed by coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback f A [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules, lem-sfb-coefficient-fixed-pullback-exact]. Write D(E),D(F) for their functors on the standard ordinary derived categories, and I for the chosen inverse equivalence of D(E). For every K in D(S) [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data] and every A-module M, there is an isomorphism D(F)(K ⊗^L_S constant_X(M)[0]) ≅ D(E)( I(D(F)(K)) ⊗^L_R constant_Y(M)[0]). The tensor is the published K-flat tensor [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated] and constant realization is [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor]. No boundedness, finite generation, Noetherianity, local constancy, or flatness is assumed.

proof.text: Give the fixed-scalar realization functors their transported normalized monoidal structures. The coefficient-sized sheaf inverse image is strong monoidal because model base change is representably flat, and is exact and a left adjoint. Constant-scalar equivalences preserve flat objects. Coefficient inverse image preserves ordinary flats by lem-sfb-coefficient-fixed-pullback-flat, hence both functors used below are flat-preserving.

For each of the two source derived objects choose a K-flat flat-term cochain representative using the existing independent-coefficient resolution theorem. The cochain tensor-model rigidity comparison computes the published tensor on these representatives. The flat-term K-flat functor theorem shows that the exact, colimit-preserving functor maps the second representative to a K-flat complex. Compose the source representative comparison, exact derived-functor factorization, the ordinary cochain monoidal comparison, and the inverse target localization tensorator. Finally map the two representative isomorphisms. This proves, for either F or E and arbitrary derived inputs, that its image of the published tensor is isomorphic to the native tensor of its two images. Only the ordinary flatness substep is left open; no derived-tensor comparison is restated.

Identify the fixed-scalar realization of the intrinsic constant module with the ordinary constant sheaf, using moduleRestrictionConstantIso and the actual scalar-restriction comparison. Constant sheaf pullback commutes with constant realization by the two constant-sheaf adjunctions, since model base change preserves the terminal object. Derive the resulting ordinary isomorphism on single complexes using mapDerivedCategoryFactors and singleMapHomologicalComplex.

Apply step 2 to F at K and constant_X(M)[0], and to E at its chosen inverse image of F(K) and constant_Y(M)[0]. The counit E(E^{-1}(F(K))) ≅ F(K), together with the constant-object isomorphism of step 3, gives an isomorphism between the two native tensors. Composing with the two comparisons from step 2 proves exactly the displayed statement, without any boundedness, finiteness or coefficient-flatness assumption.

theorem coefficient_restricted_tensor_comparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    (K : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A) (M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A) :
    let R := constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A
    let S := constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A
    let E := coefficientModelFixedScalars (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A
    let F := coefficientModelFixedScalars (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A ⋙
      coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} f A
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (Mod R)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (Mod S)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (Sheaf (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    Nonempty (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (((SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.derivedTensor S).obj K).obj
          ((Q S).obj ((HomologicalComplex.single (Mod S) (.up ℤ) 0).obj
            ((commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor
              (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A).obj M)))) ≅
      E.mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (((SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.derivedTensor R).obj
          (E.mapDerivedCategory.inv.obj (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K))).obj
            ((Q R).obj ((HomologicalComplex.single (Mod R) (.up ℤ) 0).obj
              ((commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor
                (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Y) A).obj M)))))
